answers.answer: Matches BFL's 8 GB guidance: the int8 files in ComfyUI
answers.conditions: BFL: the int8 ComfyUI files run on 8 GB GPUs such as the RTX 3070. Image model, int8 text encoder and VAE together are 11.0 GB; by our reading, on a card smaller than that ComfyUI keeps them on the GPU one at a time and needs system RAM for the rest. BFL gives no RAM figure. The prompt upsampler BFL says not to skip is a 9B model (6.72 GB w4a8, 9.75 GB int8 or 18.8 GB BF16 in ComfyUI); BFL does not say whether its 8 GB figure includes it. When it does not fit with the image model, run it on its own first (BFL's README) or switch it off in the ComfyUI template, with weaker results.
